title: Types
explain: JavaScript has different data types like numbers, strings, booleans, and objects. You can check a value's type using the typeof operator. Understanding types helps you write code that works correctly and prevents bugs.
exercise: Create three variables: one holding a number (your age), one holding a string (your name), and one holding a boolean (true or false). Use console.log with typeof to print each variable's type.
tip: typeof null returns "object" (a quirk in JavaScript), and arrays are objects too. So use Array.isArray() to specifically check for arrays instead of relying on typeof alone.
